title: Jula to nazar ayenga
body:
Jula to nazar ayenga
Jula na julawo are rona hai muqaddar ab ayenga na wo, julne walaa, Aay madar-e-asgar
(Na milengaa na milengaa) x2
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
Ab saari khudayi mei Asghar naa milenga
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab julaa julaane ko taras jayengi bahe(n), Khayme mei kabhi dasht me dhundengi nigahe
(Thak jayengi ye ankhe) X2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye soch ke rotaa hai mera dil bhi tarap kar, us waqt tere qalb pe kiyaa guzrengi muztar
(Jab raato(n) ko pehlu mei) x2 Asghar naa milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya waqt-e-musibat hai Zaraa dekh ay dukhiyaa, kal jhule mei beshir tha aur pani nahi tha
(Mil jayengaa jab pani) x2 (Asghar na milengaa)x2
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Saaye me na jawungi tu ghar lawt ke ajaa, har waqt tere hoto(n) per hongaa yahi noha
(Bin tere suku(n) maa ko) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhayenge layee(n) ham per abhi aur qayamat, dhundenge shaki dasht me beshir ki turbat
(Shuhadaa ke saro me jab) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Are bin pani ke dunya se sidhra mera Asghar, jab ayenga pani to meri pyaarisi dukhtar
(Dhundengi use ban me) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda(n) se riha ho ker jab jawonge tum ghar, har god me dhundengi bohat royengi muztar
(Jab fatema sughra ko) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hatho me uthawongi jab pani ka kuza, pani me nazar ayengaa besheer kaa chehra
<<MINI>>
(Bas aas nazar ayengaa) x2 Asghar naa milengaa
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad ayenga reh reh kar jo Asghar ka huwakla, aur shok shahadat me wo jhule me machal na
(Tum dil ko mana lena) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar ke shaluke jab nazar ayenge ghar me, ik dard se us waqt bhi uthenga jigar me
(Sab honge waha leykin) x2 Asghar na milengaa
<<MINI>>
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
Ab saari khudayi mei Asghar naa milenga
(Jula to nazar ayenga, Asghar na milengaa) x2
